key_insight: A hybrid latent-dynamics model combines a β-VAE-GAN compressor with a sensor-conditioned Transformer to forecast intermittent near-wall turbulence from sparse measurements.
engineering_relevance: This offers a reduced-order surrogate for wall-bounded CFD that can extend predictions far beyond the observed window while retaining physically meaningful flow states.
method: β-VAE-GAN compresses flow fields into a 4D latent space.
Easy Attention replaces standard self-attention to reduce temporal forecasting cost.
AdaLN-Zero conditions latent evolution on sparse sensor inputs.
evidence_signal: On the Minimal Flow Unit at Reτ = 200 and y+ = 14, the model recovers 87% of turbulent kinetic energy in the latent representation and 82% end-to-end, while forecasting over 17,288 t+ from only 128 t+ of initialization data.
watch_item: Rare, extreme-amplitude events are attenuated, so the model may underrepresent the most intermittent flow bursts.
paper_title: A Hybrid Generative Reduced-Order Model for the Minimal Flow Unit
